title: Captain Dog
description: You don’t need to worry if trouble is around the corner. Captain Dog always saves the day!
quote: Did somebody holler for a hero in a collar?
altHero: Captain Dog, superhero dog in a spotlight on a rooftop
alt1: a group of dogs looking scared as a large shadow looms
alt2: giant villain dog walks amongst skyscrapers
alt3: Captain Dog flies fast and tries to beat a train that is going to derail
alt4: Captain Dog flying into the sky to attack an alien UFO
